name: esp32-uart0
description: ESP32 on UART0 connector: EN=GPIO2, IO0=GPIO3. ROM download mode needs EN pulse while IO0 high; flash with esptool through UART0 COM port.
notes: esptool can use --before default_reset --after hard_reset with RTS/DTR only on USB-UART adapters wired to EN/IO0; here drive GPIO2/GPIO3 via this tool, then run esptool on the mapped COM port.
